Subject: Request: Net60 + spread invoicing for Q3 pilot (VAT docs attached)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the call this morning. MerchantCo is excited to move forward with the Q3 pilot but we need some flexibility on payment timing while we align our treasury calendar. Would Redwood consider Net60 for the first 90 days of the pilot?

To reduce your credit exposure we can do the following: 
- 15% upfront deposit on activation (wire)
- Remaining invoices split 50/50 across two monthly invoices (so we receive two equal invoices covering usage)
- We will provide VAT certificate and bank authorization (attached) and can get a payment security letter from our parent if needed

If Net60 is a hard no, we can consider Net45 but we prefer Net60. Please let me know what proofs you need to expedite internal approval.

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for the attachments. Appreciate the clarity. A few quick points from our side: 

1) We can potentially support a temporary Net60 for a 90-day pilot provided we get the 15% activation deposit cleared and a signed conditional credit letter that outlines the split invoicing cadence and fallback to Net30 on sustained usage.
2) To process Net60 we need: VAT certificate (received), proof of bank authorization (received), and the parent company security letter or a banking reference.
3) We typically apply an early-pay discount on invoices paid within 10 days (1.5%) — happy to discuss applying that to the first two invoices as an incentive.

If those conditions are acceptable I will draft a short credit letter and loop in Finance and Sales Ops to set up the invoice schedule. Monica, can you confirm whether our billing system can auto-split monthly usage into two equal invoices and flag the account with a temporary Net60 term code?

Elena — one more ask: if you can share the expected monthly run-rate for the pilot (ballpark), we can cap the temporary credit corridor and avoid manual approvals.
